summary_en: Interim dividend per share for the fiscal year ending March 2027 raised from 45 yen to 50 yen. Full-year dividend forecast increased from 115 yen to 120 yen per share.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Interim Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On October 13, 2026, Tsutsumi Jewelry's board of directors revised the interim dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend per share was increased from 45 yen to 50 yen, raising the full-year dividend forecast from 115 yen to 120 yen per share.

The company stated that it positions profit distribution to shareholders as a key management priority and pursues stable, continuous dividend payments while strengthening earnings and financial condition. The revision reflects a comprehensive assessment of recent business performance, financial condition, and capital efficiency.
